positive.prompt: Flowly's MCP tools aren't showing up in my session and every call comes back 401
How do I point my MCP client at our Flowly instance and prove the credential works?
A Flowly tool call came back saying my credential doesn't hold some scope — do I need a new one?
Set this repo up to talk to our Flowly instance over MCP — I have the URL but nothing connects

negative.prompt: The tests started failing after my last change — find the root cause
Harden this endpoint that accepts untrusted user input before we ship it

evals.prompt: Flowly's tools aren't available in this session — the door keeps answering 503. Just write up the plan for FLO-1201 so we don't lose the work.
evals.expected_output: The 503 identified as the agent door being switched off rather than a credential problem, with the plan held in the conversation and no planning artifact written to the working tree
expectations: The agent names 503 as the door being switched off and says a new credential would not change the answer
The agent does not rotate, reissue, or ask for a different credential in response to the 503
No plan, todo, spec, or status file is written to the working tree as a substitute for the Flowly planning docs
The agent proposes an identity call with whoami as the check once the operator re-enables the door
No instance hostname or URL is invented, guessed, or written into a file
